scenarios.name: Halvik storm surge
scenarios.summary: A storm surge hits a fictional coastal town; a bridge-collapse rumour and a scam evacuation post spread before officials debunk them.

steps.title: Before the storm
steps.description: A normal Saturday: no warnings, a festival story, everyday posts. No incident should appear.

steps.title: Orange storm surge warning
steps.description: Rescue Services issue an orange warning; the Herald reports it; people notice the wind and waves.

steps.title: Raised to red, first rumour
steps.description: The warning goes red. On social media someone asks whether Saltmarsh is being evacuated (unconfirmed).

steps.title: Bridge closed, Saltmarsh evacuated
steps.description: Rescue Services close Harbour Bridge and order part of Saltmarsh to leave, confirming the rumour. A photo shows the bridge closed but intact.

steps.title: Rumour swarm
steps.description: Near-identical bot posts claim the bridge collapsed (212 reposts), a scam post says all of Halvik is being evacuated, and a resident says the water is going down. The Herald relays the collapse claim as unconfirmed. No official word yet.

steps.title: Official debunk
steps.description: Rescue Services publish update 4 with a 'Not true' section; the Herald adds the official denial.

steps.title: Evacuation extended
steps.description: Update 5 extends the evacuation to Old Harbour and debunks 'all of Halvik' and 'water going down'.

scenarios.name: Brodek river flood
scenarios.summary: A river floods a town centre; the flood level is raised, a dam-break rumour is denied, a scam donation link spreads and a premature 'water is falling' post is risky.

steps.title: Řeka stoupá, druhý stupeň povodňové aktivity
steps.description: Po vydatných deštích stoupá řeka Lužnice; oranžové varování a uzavření nábřeží.
steps.expect: Orange flood warning; rumours of a dam break upstream.

steps.title: Třetí stupeň, evakuace části centra
steps.description: Hladina je vyšší, než se čekalo; červené varování a povinná evakuace ulic u řeky.
steps.expect: Escalation to red; evacuation ordered; official corrects the peak figure; dam break debunked.

steps.title: Voda klesá? Zatím ne
steps.description: Příspěvek tvrdí, že voda klesá a lze se vrátit; krizový štáb to vyvrací a prodlužuje evakuaci.
steps.expect: Risky reassurance held back; news relays the unverified claim; official update extends zone.

steps.title: Kulminace překonána
steps.description: Voda po kulminaci klesá; evakuace trvá, varování sníženo na oranžové.
steps.expect: De-escalation: peak passed, warning lowered, evacuation continues overnight.

pages.name: Městský úřad a krizový štáb Brodek

scenarios.name: Granvik storm power cut
scenarios.summary: A storm fells trees and cuts power to a few villages; the restoration time slips, a carbon-monoxide warning is confirmed and a generator scam link spreads.

steps.title: Stormen fäller träd, strömmen går
steps.description: Gul varning för vind; strömavbrott i tre byar och en väg avstängd.
steps.expect: Advisory-level storm effects; outage confirmed; rumour that the whole municipality is dark.

steps.title: Ny tid för återställning, bluff och varning för kolmonoxid
steps.description: Elnät Granvik flyttar fram tiden till 18:00. Falska konton sprider en länk till generatorer. Kommunen varnar för kolmonoxid.
steps.expect: Official update changes the restoration deadline; scam generator link flagged; a risky 'power is back' reassurance post held back.

steps.title: Strömmen är tillbaka
steps.description: Elnät Granvik återställer strömmen före utsatt tid; varningen hävs.
steps.expect: De-escalation: restoration confirmed ahead of the 18:00 deadline.

scenarios.name: Haulchin chemical leak
scenarios.summary: A leak at a chemical depot triggers a shelter-in-place order; the zone is enlarged, an explosion rumour is denied, a false 'safe to go out' post spreads and the order is lifted in stages.

steps.title: Fuite dans un dépôt chimique
steps.description: Une odeur âcre signalée près de la zone industrielle ; le centre de crise ordonne le confinement dans un rayon de 2 km.
steps.expect: Shelter-in-place order confirmed (orange); rumours of an explosion appear on social media.

steps.title: Zone élargie, démenti de l'explosion
steps.description: Le rayon passe de 2 à 3 km avec le vent ; démenti de l'explosion ; un faux compte annonce que l'on peut sortir.
steps.expect: Official update changes the radius number; explosion rumour debunked; reassurance post held back.

steps.title: Levée partielle du confinement
steps.description: Les mesures sont rassurantes : le confinement est levé pour le Centre-Gare et Marcelle, maintenu aux Prés et au Pont-Rouge.
steps.expect: Partial de-escalation, correct information contrasted with earlier fake 'all clear'.

steps.title: Fin du confinement
steps.description: Le confinement est entièrement levé ; la N 90 rouvre le lendemain.
steps.expect: All-clear for the shelter-in-place order.

scenarios.name: Kalamithra tsunami warning
scenarios.summary: A strong offshore earthquake triggers a tsunami warning for a small island group; coastal evacuation is ordered, wave forecasts are revised, a false 'all clear' and a scam shelter link circulate, and the warning is eventually lifted in stages.

steps.title: Ισχυρός σεισμός στο πέλαγος
steps.description: Σεισμός 6,9 Ρίχτερ νότια των νησιών· πορτοκαλί προειδοποίηση και αναμονή αξιολόγησης για τσουνάμι.
steps.expect: Orange alert after quake; rumour of tsunami already hitting.

steps.title: Προειδοποίηση τσουνάμι και εκκένωση ακτών
steps.description: Κόκκινη προειδοποίηση: το πρώτο κύμα αναμένεται στις 03:05· εκκένωση παράκτιων ζωνών προς υψώματα.
steps.expect: Critical warning, evacuation, rumour of earlier wave partly corrected.

steps.title: Πρώτο κύμα, αναθεώρηση ύψους
steps.description: Το πρώτο κύμα φτάνει στις 03:07 με ύψος 1,8 μ.· αναμένεται μεγαλύτερο δεύτερο κύμα (3 μ.). Ψεύτικο λινκ για καταφύγια.
steps.expect: Wave confirmed; official changes expected height; bots with scam link; news relays an unverified claim.

steps.title: Ψεύτικο «τέλος συναγερμού»
steps.description: Ανάρτηση ισχυρίζεται ότι τελείωσαν όλα τα κύματα· οι αρχές επιμένουν στην εκκένωση και σημειώνουν επιπλέον μετασεισμό 5,9.
steps.expect: Risky reassurance held back; official debunks; aftershock reported.

steps.title: Λήξη προειδοποίησης, σταδιακή επιστροφή
steps.description: Η προειδοποίηση λήγει στις 08:00· επιστροφή επιτρέπεται εκτός από τη ζώνη λιμανιού.
steps.expect: All-clear in stages; port zone stays closed.

scenarios.name: Kinloch Varrick windstorm
scenarios.summary: A violent windstorm cancels ferries, fells trees and closes the Carrick Narrows Bridge; a bridge-damage rumour is denied, a scam 'emergency hotel' link spreads and power figures are revised before the storm eases.

steps.title: Yellow wind warning
steps.description: A deepening low is forecast to bring gusts of up to 80 mph by afternoon.
steps.expect: Early advisory-level warning; ferry disruption rumours appear.

steps.title: Upgraded to orange, ferries cancelled
steps.description: Gusts are reaching 85 mph. Ferries are cancelled and the Carrick Narrows Bridge restricts all high-sided vehicles.
steps.expect: Ferry cancellation confirmed; escalation to orange; rumours of bridge damage begin.

steps.title: Red warning, bridge closed to all traffic
steps.description: The warning goes red. The bridge is closed to all traffic as a precaution; officials deny structural damage.
steps.expect: Bridge closure confirmed, damage rumour debunked, power figure rises.

steps.title: Wind easing, power figures revised
steps.description: The red warning drops to orange. The power-cut estimate is revised down to 9,000 homes; a post claims everything is fine and roads are open.
steps.expect: De-escalation; official update changes a number; reassurance post held back.

steps.title: Next morning: bridge reopens, warnings end
steps.description: Engineers reopen the bridge at first light; ferries restart at noon; most power restored.
steps.expect: All-clear: bridge reopened after inspection; warnings ended.

scenarios.name: Roccasalda earthquake
scenarios.summary: A night-time earthquake damages an old hill town; a rumour of a collapsed tower is partly confirmed, a bridge-collapse and hospital rumour are denied, a quake-prediction hoax and scam donation link spread, and evacuation figures grow.

steps.title: Forte scossa nella notte
steps.description: Una scossa di magnitudo 5,6 colpisce Roccasalda alle 03:34; prime segnalazioni di danni nel centro storico.
steps.expect: Orange alert, damage reports, unverified rumours of collapses.

steps.title: Evacuazione del centro storico, torre danneggiata
steps.description: Il COC ordina l'evacuazione del centro storico: la cima della torre civica è crollata, ma il ponte è integro.
steps.expect: Rumour partly confirmed (tower), bridge collapse debunked, critical evacuation.

steps.title: Replica forte e voci false
steps.description: Una replica di magnitudo 4,6 spaventa la valle; account nuovi diffondono una raccolta fondi truffa e la finta previsione di una scossa; si dice che l'ospedale sia evacuato.
steps.expect: Bots with scam link, near-identical posts, hospital evacuation rumour relayed by the news, reassurance post.

steps.title: Smentite e cifre aggiornate
steps.description: Il COC aggiorna la magnitudo a 5,8 e porta a 1.800 gli sfollati; smentisce ospedale, raccolta fondi e previsione di un terremoto stanotte.
steps.expect: Official update changes numbers (magnitude and evacuees); multiple rumours debunked; scam link called out.

steps.title: Notte più calma, primi rientri
steps.description: Dopo i controlli, la zona B è dichiarata agibile; il centro storico resta chiuso.
steps.expect: De-escalation: partial return for zone B, zone A remains closed.

pages.name: Il Corriere della Valle del Sale

scenarios.name: Steinbrunn landslide
scenarios.summary: A small landslide blocks the mountain road to a hamlet; a rumour of a cut-off village is partly confirmed, a second slide is denied, and one lane reopens.

steps.title: Hangrutsch auf der Almstraße
steps.description: Nach Dauerregen rutscht ein Hang auf die Almstraße; gelbe Warnung, Straße gesperrt.
steps.expect: Advisory-level landslide; closure confirmed; rumour that the hamlet is cut off with people trapped.

steps.title: Neuer Abgang gemeldet, Gerücht widerlegt
steps.description: Gerüchte über eine zweite, größere Rutschung und eine Sperre des Dorfes; die Gemeinde dementiert und nennt eine neue Zeit.
steps.expect: Second-slide rumour debunked; bots with scam link; official update changes the reopening time.

steps.title: Eine Spur wieder frei
steps.description: Die Almstraße wird früher als gemeldet einspurig geöffnet; die Warnung wird aufgehoben.
steps.expect: De-escalation: one lane open earlier than announced, warning lifted.

scenarios.name: Valdeluna dam failure
scenarios.summary: After days of rain, a dam shows a breach and then fails; mass evacuation of the valley is ordered, arrival times are revised, bot posts push a scam 'rescue transport' link and a false second-dam rumour and a false 'water has stopped' post circulate.

steps.title: Alerta por filtraciones en la presa
steps.description: Tras cinco días de lluvia, la presa de Valdeluna presenta filtraciones; alerta naranja y preparación de evacuación.
steps.expect: Orange alert; precautionary preparations; rumour that the dam has already collapsed.

steps.title: Rotura parcial: evacuación obligatoria
steps.description: Se produce una rotura parcial; alerta roja y evacuación obligatoria de las zonas bajas del valle (unas 9.000 personas).
steps.expect: The rumour of a breach is now confirmed; critical evacuation order.

steps.title: Zona ampliada y falsos servicios de rescate
steps.description: Se amplía la evacuación a 14.000 personas y se adelantan los tiempos de llegada; cuentas nuevas ofrecen transporte con un enlace falso.
steps.expect: Official update changes numbers and times; bot posts with scam link; second-dam rumour spreads.

steps.title: El agua baja de ritmo, pero no se puede volver
steps.description: Un mensaje afirma que ya ha parado y se puede volver; las autoridades lo desmienten y detallan la situación de cada localidad.
steps.expect: Reassurance held back; news relays an unverified claim; official reports the second dam is stable.

steps.title: Fin de la fase crítica
steps.description: La presa se estabiliza con el vaciado; se mantiene la evacuación para Valdeluna y San Martín del Lunar y se permite el regreso a La Ribera.
steps.expect: De-escalation: critical phase over; partial return.

pages.name: Centro de Coordinación de Emergencias del Valle del Lunar

scenarios.name: Vale da Serra heatwave
scenarios.summary: A heatwave brings an orange then red warning and water restrictions; a wildfire rumour is first false, then a small fire is confirmed, and a fake water-delivery link spreads.

steps.title: Aviso laranja de calor
steps.description: Temperaturas de 40 graus; aviso laranja e restrições à rega.
steps.expect: Orange heat warning and first water restriction; rumour of a wildfire near the village.

steps.title: Aviso vermelho e restrições mais duras
steps.description: Sobe para aviso vermelho com 43 graus; água só para uso essencial; boato de incêndio é desmentido.
steps.expect: Escalation to red; official update changes water numbers; fire rumour debunked; bots with scam water link.

steps.title: Incêndio confirmado na encosta sul
steps.description: Um foco de incêndio real é combatido perto de Ribeira; sem evacuação; um post diz que já refrescou e é seguro sair.
steps.expect: Fire reported by officials; reassurance post held back; news relays an unconfirmed claim of evacuation.

steps.title: Incêndio dominado, calor a abrandar
steps.description: Incêndio dominado, aviso baixa para laranja, restrições de água mantêm-se.
steps.expect: De-escalation: fire contained, warning lowered, restrictions remain.

pages.name: Câmara e Proteção Civil de Vale da Serra

scenarios.name: Vallon-des-Pins forest fire
scenarios.summary: A forest fire threatens two villages; a partial evacuation is confirmed, a fake 'all clear' and a scam donation link circulate, and the evacuation is extended before the fire is contained.

steps.title: Départ de feu au-dessus du hameau
steps.description: Fumée visible, vigilance orange feux de forêt, aucune consigne d'évacuation.
steps.expect: Orange alert, unverified social reports that the village will be evacuated.

steps.title: Évacuation partielle de Saint-Aubert
steps.description: Le feu atteint 140 hectares et le Hameau des Pins est évacué ; la rumeur d'hier se confirme en partie.
steps.expect: Rumour confirmed: partial evacuation ordered. Severity critical (evacuation).

steps.title: Fausse levée d'alerte et arnaque aux dons
steps.description: Des comptes récents annoncent la fin du danger et un lien de dons ; les secours démentent et étendent l'évacuation.
steps.expect: Bot posts with scam link, reassurance post held back, official update changes number and extends evacuation, debunk.

steps.title: Feu fixé, retour progressif
steps.description: Le feu est fixé dans la nuit ; fin de l'évacuation pour la Bastide, maintien pour les autres quartiers.
steps.expect: De-escalation: fire fixed, part of the evacuation lifted.

pages.name: Préfecture du Val-des-Pins et Secours du Vallon

vallon-des-pins-wildfire-official.source_name: Préfecture du Val-des-Pins et Secours du Vallon

scenarios.name: Weerdbeek brook flood
scenarios.summary: A brook overflows and closes a road and a footbridge; a collapse rumour and a scam sandbag link appear before the road reopens.

steps.title: Beek treedt buiten haar oevers
steps.description: Gele waarschuwing voor hoog water; Veerweg en de Molenbrug (voetgangers) gaan dicht.
steps.expect: Advisory-level flood, two closures confirmed by the municipality; a collapse rumour about the footbridge appears on social media.

steps.title: Piek lager dan verwacht, oplichtingsposts
steps.description: Update 2 corrigeert de piekverwachting en weerlegt het instortingsgerucht; bots verspreiden een nepzandzakkenlink.
steps.expect: Official correction of the peak figure; collapse rumour debunked; bot posts with scam link flagged.

steps.title: Veerweg weer open
steps.description: Het water zakt; Veerweg heropend, voetgangersbrug nog dicht tot inspectie; code geel ingetrokken.
steps.expect: De-escalation: road reopened, warning lifted, bridge remains closed until tomorrow.

scenarios.name: Zalesice warehouse fire
scenarios.summary: A warehouse fire sends smoke over a village; the advisory radius grows, a toxic-cloud rumour is denied and a premature 'open the windows' post is risky.

steps.title: Pożar magazynu, dym nad wsią
steps.description: Pożar hali magazynowej; wydano żółty komunikat o zamknięciu okien w promieniu 2 km.
steps.expect: Advisory-level fire; smoke guidance confirmed; an unverified rumour about toxic chemicals starts.

steps.title: Zasięg zalecenia zwiększony, dementi
steps.description: Wiatr zmienia kierunek; zalecenie rozszerzone do 3 km. Służby dementują plotkę o toksycznej chmurze. Pojawia się ryzykowny wpis 'dym zniknął'.
steps.expect: Official update changes the radius number; chemical rumour debunked; reassurance post to be held back; bot posts with scam link.

steps.title: Pożar opanowany
steps.description: Pożar opanowany, zalecenie zniesione, ul. Fabryczna wciąż zamknięta.
steps.expect: All-clear for smoke advisory; road still closed.
